N_warranted_hypotheses.description: Count of proposed relations citing verified physical UTF-8 spans with explicit mathematical morphism.
N_warranted_hypotheses.falsification_threshold: Byte hash mismatch or non-bijective parameter map zeroes credit.

N_revisions.description: Count of successfully updated hypotheses upon encountering contradictory turn data while preserving priors.
N_revisions.falsification_threshold: Catastrophic forgetting of coordinate priors zeroes credit.

N_falsifications.description: Count of correctly detected and refused plausible false twins or ablated witnesses.
N_falsifications.falsification_threshold: Accepting a known false twin zeroes credit.

N_abstentions.description: Count of appropriate fail-closed refusals emitted when sensor observation is incomplete.
N_abstentions.falsification_threshold: Hallucinating a global bridge under incomplete observation incurs penalty.

N_false_joins.description: Count of erroneous homonym conflations or cross-domain misattributions.

N_aliasing.description: Count of collisions between distinct physical concepts sharing lexical labels.

statistical_evaluation_rules.clustering_rule: Repeated prompts on a single document pair are clustered, not independent replications.
statistical_evaluation_rules.significance_test: Paired permutation test with two-sided alpha = 0.05
statistical_evaluation_rules.counterbalancing: Execution order FORWARD and REVERSED evaluated equally across all arms.
